summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on the slow performance of the analytics dashboard, particularly when running queries for long periods (e.g., six months or more) across large regions.

It was noted that the current production version is not fully optimized. A suggestion was made to run data analysis using the staging environment with the PROD dataset to achieve better performance.

[me] provided updates on ongoing optimization efforts, including deploying a hotfix intended to reduce server load by mitigating heavy queries. The primary solution for improving performance will be the creation of new fast aggregates.
decisions: Use staging environment with PROD dataset for long-period data analysis
Deploying a hotfix to reduce server load from heavy dashboard queries
action_items: Develop and deploy new fast aggregates to significantly improve performance
